{{Short description|German chemist (1942)}}
'''Dieter Fenske''' (born 29. September 1942) is a German [[inorganic chemist]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal|last1=Adams|first1=Richard D.|last2=Müller|first2=Achim|last3=Schmid|first3=Günter|date=2007-09-01|title=Foreword: A Special Issue to Dieter Fenske|journal=Journal of Cluster Science|language=en|volume=18|issue=3|pages=473–475|doi=10.1007/s10876-007-0107-z|s2cid=97409159|issn=1572-8862}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.haw.uni-heidelberg.de/akademie/mitglied.de.html?id=45|title=HAdW Mitglied|website=www.haw.uni-heidelberg.de|access-date=2018-12-21}}</ref>

== Life ==
Fenske studied [[chemistry]] at the [[University of Münster]], received his PhD in 1973 and his [[Habilitation]] in 1978.<ref name=":0" /> He is Professor for [[Inorganic chemistry]] at the [[University of Karlsruhe]] and Director at the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030417015410/http://www.fzk.de/int/ Institute for Nanotechnology (INT)] of [http://www.fzk.de Forschungszentrum Karlsruhe].<ref name=":0" />

[[Image:ASUTAJ = CCDB code. Ag-S nanocrystal as described in doi 10.1002SLASHanie.200352351.png|thumb|444 px|center|Nanoscale [[Phosphine]]-stabilized Ag-S cluster prepared by Fenske et al. Color code: gray = Ag, violet = P, orange = S.<ref>{{cite journal|author1=Fenske, D.|author2=Persau, C.|author3=Dehnen, S.|author4=Anson, C. E.|title=Syntheses and Crystal Structures of the Ag-S Cluster Compounds [Ag<sub>70</sub>S<sub>20</sub>(SPh)<sub>28</sub>(dppm)<sub>10</sub>] (CF<sub>3</sub>CO<sub>2</sub>)<sub>2</sub> and [Ag<sub>262</sub>S<sub>100</sub>(St-Bu)<sub>62</sub>(dppb)<sub>6</sub>]|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition|year=2004|volume=43|issue=3|pages=305–309|doi=10.1002/anie.200352351|pmid=14705083}}</ref>]]

== Awards ==
In 1991, he received the [[Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize]] of the [[Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft]].<ref name=":0" />  In 1993, he was awarded the Wilhelm-Klemm Award of the [[Society of German Chemists]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.gdch.de/gdch/preise-und-auszeichnungen/gdch-preise.html|title=GDCh-Preise {{!}} Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker e.V.|website=www.gdch.de|language=de|access-date=2018-12-21}}</ref> Since 1999, he is a full member of the [[Heidelberg Academy of Sciences and Humanities]].<ref name=":1" /> In 2005, he received a Doctor honoris causa title from the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] in Novosibirsk.<ref name=":0" /> Since 2007, he is a member of the [[Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.leopoldina.org/mitglieder/mitgliederverzeichnis/member/1231/|title=Mitgliederverzeichnis|website=www.leopoldina.org|language=de|access-date=2018-12-21}}</ref>
